prompt: I lost a final against Greg Rusedski on grass, who won his 4th career singles title on grass against a player that once defeated me in the opening round of the US Open. I achieved my highest ranking in singles on what date?
answer:
The player was **Javier Frana**. He lost to Greg Rusedski in the 1993 Newport final, and Mardy Fish—Rusedski’s opponent for his fourth grass-court title—later defeated Frana in the first round of the US Open.

Frana achieved his career-high singles ranking of **No. 30 on May 8, 1995**.
